item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this pic, quick pls.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t edit it because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

For a quick manual fix: crop to head-and-shoulders, slightly lower highlights, lift shadows, and blur the kitchen background for a cleaner, more professional look.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make this photo into a natural polished professional headshot. Preserve the man's exact facial identity, age, silver hair, facial hair, natural skin texture and expression. Replace gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp pale blue open-collar shirt. Replace kitchen with a clean softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft even professional portrait lighting, balanced exposure and natural color. Keep same head and shoulders pose and square framing. Realistic photography, subtle retouching only, no text.
